title: Stable and Gaussian Fluctuation Limit of a Lévy-Driven Slow-Fast System with Polynomial Dissipation
summary: We study fluctuation limit of a slow-fast system driven by $α$-stable Lévy noise with $1 0.$ Although the noise is given, the fluctuation limit is either a stable process or a Brownian motion, depending on both $p$ and $α.$ The critical line between stable limit and Brownian limit is $q+1-p=α/2.$
